relationships.subject: depression
relationships.evidence_quote: depression is uniquely associated with worse interictal burden and increase the MIBS-4 score by 0.74 (SE = 0.34) points

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: one recent clinical trial of galcanezumab demonstrated that treatment lowered interictal burden compared with placebo

key_findings: Two-thirds of 506 migraine patients had severe interictal burden; it was independently associated with HIT-6, migraine days, depression and CGRP mAb treatment status.
